test_davis_dataset_builder: test the Davis dataset builder with 480p and full_resolution configs using fake examples
test_davis_annotations_classes: test that train segmentations contain classes {0,1} and validation contain {0,1,2}
test_davis_dataset_shapes: test that video frames are (4, H, W, 3) and segmentations are (4, H, W, 1) for both splits
test_davis_num_frames_metadata: test that metadata num_frames equals 4 for both train and validation examples
run_davis_test_main: run the Davis dataset test suite via tfds.testing.test_main()
